تتعاطون (form VI)
# تَتَعَاطَوْنَ (tataʕāṭawna) /ta.ta.ʕaː.tˤaw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of تَعَاطَى (taʕāṭā)
# تُتَعَاطَوْنَ (tutaʕāṭawna) /tu.ta.ʕaː.tˤaw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of تَعَاطَى (taʕāṭā)
